cases.description: Clean valid pass case for a multi-platform solo vocalist with Linktree expansion, verified MusicBrainz MBID, and sanitized mgmt contact routing.
cases.brief: Resolve canonical identity, contact route, and link graph for unranked discovery lead lead_mira_sol (Mira Sol, NYC solo vocalist).
cases.context: Tool simon_db.get('leads', 'lead_mira_sol') returned lead with stage_name 'Mira Sol' and seed URL 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ'. Tool url_context returned description: 'Mira Sol (she/her) — solo vocalist & singer-songwriter based in Bushwick, NYC. Neo-soul & indie folk. Mgmt: North Star Artists (mgmt@northstar.example). Distributed by DistroKid. Produced by Jonah Reyes.' Outbound URLs: https://linktr.ee/mirasolmusic, https://www.instagram.com/mirasolmusic. Following Linktree returned Spotify (https://open.spotify.com/artist/123456), Bandcamp (https://mirasol.bandcamp.com), and SoundCloud (https://soundcloud.com/mirasol). MusicBrainz WS/2 query for 'Mira Sol' + 'New York, NY' returned MBID '11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555' and alias 'M. Sol'.

source_and_media_queue.bio_text: Mira Sol (she/her) — solo vocalist & singer-songwriter based in Bushwick, NYC. Neo-soul & indie folk. Management via North Star Artists. Distributed by DistroKid. Produced by Jonah Reyes.

process_trace.notes: Extracted canonical stage name, pronouns, city, neighborhood, and mgmt contact route; scrubbed raw mgmt email.
Resolved MusicBrainz MBID 11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555, extracted DSP URLs from Linktree, classified solo_vocalist project.
